scripts.start: npx -y concurrently -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "cyan.bold,magenta.bold" "npm run backend" "npm run frontend"
scripts.stop: lsof -ti :8000 -ti :5173 | xargs kill -9 2>/dev/null || echo 'No active services running on ports 8000/5173'
scripts.backend: cd backend && (venv/bin/python3 -m uvicorn app.main:app --reload --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000 || python3 -m uvicorn app.main:app --reload --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000)
